```plato
//==
// # Deformations — Eval bodies and apply lifts
//
// Bodies for IDeformation2D/IDeformation3D (`deformations.concepts.plato`) on the
// catalog types in `deformations.types.plato`, plus lifts onto IDeformable2D/3D and
// point sugar. Weighted apply takes a ScalarField as a separate modulator —
// falloff is never a field of the warp itself.
//
// Normals contract: Eval moves points only. After deforming meshes, recompute
// normals from the new positions (no analytic Jacobian in this library yet).

library Deformations
{
    //==
    // # Helpers

    // Rotate the displacement from origin to point about axis by angle, then
    // re-seat at origin. Shared by Twist3D and Bend3D.
    RotateAboutAxis(origin: Point3D, axis: Direction3D, angle: Angle, point: Point3D): Point3D
        => origin + origin.Between(point).Transform(Quaternion(AxisAngle(axis, angle)));
```
